mapper.sql:
FROM product p JOIN product_sku s ON s.product_id=p.id WHERE p.enabled=TRUE AND s.enabled=TRUE AND p.category=#{request.category} AND LOWER(p.brand)=LOWER(#{request.brand}) AND s.price >= #{request.minPrice} AND s.price <= #{request.maxPrice} AND s.stock > 0
AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sku_attribute a WHERE a.sku_id=s.id AND a.attr_key='color' AND LOWER(a.attr_value)=LOWER(#{request.color}))
AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sku_attribute a WHERE a.sku_id=s.id AND a.attr_key='size' AND LOWER(a.attr_value)=LOWER(#{request.size}))
AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM product_attribute a WHERE a.product_id=p.id AND a.attr_key='material' AND LOWER(a.attr_value)=LOWER(#{request.material}))
AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM product_attribute a WHERE a.product_id=p.id AND a.attr_key='useCase' AND LOWER(a.attr_value)=LOWER(#{request.useCase}))
AND (LOWER(p.name) LIKE #{term} ESCAPE '!' OR LOWER(p.brand) LIKE #{term} ESCAPE '!' OR LOWER(p.summary) LIKE #{term} ESCAPE '!' OR LOWER(p.category) LIKE #{term} ESCAPE '!' OR LOWER(s.spec) LIKE #{term} ESCAPE '!' OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM product_attribute a WHERE a.product_id=p.id AND LOWER(a.attr_value) LIKE #{term} ESCAPE '!') OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sku_attribute a WHERE a.sku_id=s.id AND LOWER(a.attr_value) LIKE #{term} ESCAPE '!'))
p.enabled=TRUE AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM product_sku x WHERE x.product_id=p.id AND x.enabled=TRUE) AND p.category=#{category}
